label: Sync From Source Control Repo
mcp_tool_description: Import or refresh CloudBolt content from a branch of a Source Control Repository, the same as the Create from Repository and Refresh from Remote Source actions in the UI. Give the branch name (it must not contain a slash) and the repo-relative paths of the content folders or metadata files to sync, one per line, for example blueprints/BP-abc12345 or resource_actions/RSA-abc12345/RSA-abc12345_metadata.json. Dependencies (plugins, shared modules, forms) are imported with their parent, so list only the parents. Returns syncJobId, the global id of the sourcecodereposync job: poll it with fetch_job_log and read syncResults for the per-object status. Existing objects are refreshed and their remote source URL is re-pointed at the branch, so sync the same objects from the default branch again after the branch merges. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
